items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: What's that young boy, Sir Charles somebody?

ctx.x: That's an awful feeling. So, they was working at a place called Club Sudan (phonetic). I was in the relief band. I was up there singing the blues and I had a little short trumpet up there and we was swinging pretty good too.
They had some beautiful musicians -- they had Fats up there, they had Dizzy, they had everybody who was anybody. What's that young boy, Sir Charles somebody?
